5900.name: Poliva Liquid Vanilla – 1L
5900.description:
Poliva Liquid Vanilla – 1L

High-quality liquid vanilla flavoring that adds a rich vanilla taste to desserts and baked goods.
Perfect for cakes, cookies, creams, and beverages.
A small amount delivers a strong, consistent aroma in every recipe.
A practical choice for bakeries, cafés, and home use.

5902.name: Liquid Lemon Flavor – 1L
5902.description:
Liquid Lemon Flavor – 1L

Refreshing liquid lemon flavoring that adds a citrus taste to desserts and beverages.
Perfect for cakes, creams, juices, and cold drinks.
A small amount delivers a fresh, consistent flavor in every recipe.
A practical choice for bakeries, cafés, and home use.

4204.name: Iced Grape Drink
4204.description: Refresh yourself with a naturally sweet taste with Iced Grape Drink 🍇❄️. A chilled, refreshing beverage combining natural grape flavor with icy coolness for a revitalizing experience in every sip.

4614.name: Flamingo Milkshake
4614.description: Try a tropical refreshment with Flamingo Milkshake 🦩🥤. A rich, creamy blend of delicious fruity flavors that brings fun and energy, like a bright summer day in every sip.
